"github.copilot.chat.codeGeneration.instructions": [
  {
    "text": "Always add a comment: 'Generated by Copilot'."
  },
  {
    "text": "Work in the static storefront project under `ShoopingApp/` using plain HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Keep the implementation lightweight and consistent with the existing single-page shopping flow."
  },
  {
    "text": "Preserve the current product catalog, navigation, cart, and checkout flow. Do not add a backend, authentication, database, or framework unless the task explicitly requires it."
  },
  {
    "text": "Keep changes small and readable. Update the relevant Playwright coverage in `tests/app.spec.js` when a user-visible behavior changes."
  },
  {
    "text": "When validating the app, prefer `npm test` from the workspace root so the configured local server serves the storefront from `./ShoopingApp`."
  }
]
